mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, doc_number AS docNumber, line_no AS lineNo, material_id AS materialId, material_code AS materialCode, material_name AS materialName, model, display_name AS displayName, display_model AS displayModel, brand, unit, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, amount, remark, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM warehouse_doc_item WHERE doc_number = #{docNumber} ORDER BY line_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_doc_item ( uuid, doc_number, line_no, material_id, material_code, material_name, model, display_name, display_model, brand, unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, remark, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{docNumber}, #{lineNo}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{model}, #{displayName}, #{displayModel}, #{brand}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
